definitions.gloss: maternal side, mother's side of the family
definitions.explanation: The relatives and lineage on one's mother's side. Used when distinguishing between maternal and paternal family connections.

examples.japanese: {母方|ははかた}の{祖母|そぼ}は{九十歳|きゅうじっさい}だ。
examples.english: My maternal grandmother is ninety years old.

examples.japanese: {母方|ははかた}の{親戚|しんせき}は{北海道|ほっかいどう}に{多|おお}い。
examples.english: I have many relatives on my mother's side in Hokkaido.

examples.japanese: {母方|ははかた}の{家系|かけい}にはお{医者|いしゃ}さんが{多|おお}いと{聞|き}いている。
examples.english: I've heard that there are many doctors on my mother's side of the family.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a modifier with の: {母方|ははかた}の + family member. The most common combinations are with {祖父|そふ} (grandfather), {祖母|そぼ} (grandmother), {親戚|しんせき} (relatives), and {家系|かけい} (family line).

CONTRASTING TERM:
- {父方|ちちかた}: paternal side, father's side of the family

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {母方|ははかた}の{祖父|そふ}: maternal grandfather
- {母方|ははかた}の{祖母|そぼ}: maternal grandmother
- {母方|ははかた}の{親戚|しんせき}: maternal relatives
- {母方|ははかた}の{家系|かけい}: maternal family line
